Non payées : le client doit encore payer: Unpaid: the client still has to pay. To finish: an invoice started but not done yet. Paid: it's settled. All: everything together. Tap an invoice to review it, resend it to the client or mark it paid.
La TPS et la TVQ reçues sur tes factures: The GST and QST collected on your invoices, minus what you paid on your expenses (keep the receipts: they're your proof). It's an estimate for your return to Revenu Québec.
Le mode vitrine, c'est l'app en panneaux: Showcase mode is the app as glass panels over a coloured background. Pick your colours: Sand follows your phone (light by day, dark at night); the others always stay the same. It's for the whole garage: every phone on the team changes by itself.
Le VIN, c'est le numéro de série de l'au: The VIN is the car's serial number: 17 letters and numbers. It's on the sticker in the driver's door frame, or at the bottom of the windshield on the driver's side. Scan it: the year, make, model and engine fill in by themselves.
L'agenda est découpé en cases de {s0}. T: The schedule is split into {s0} slots. Tap + or − to lengthen or shorten the appointment: the length in hours shows right below.
Chaque job passe par 4 étapes : Planifié: Each job goes through 4 steps: Scheduled, On the way, On site, Done. Tap the big black button to go to the next step.
Tu trouves autre chose à réparer ? Écris: Found something else to fix? Write it down with its price. The client approves by signing on your phone or by text, and it's added to the invoice. Nothing is done without their OK.
Une photo avant de commencer et une aprè: A photo before you start and one after: that's your proof if the client disputes. The signature confirms the client agrees with the work.
La fiche technique garde l'huile, le fil: The spec sheet keeps the oil, filter and parts for this engine. A mechanic fills it in just once: after that, it shows for every car with the same engine.
Ce qui a vraiment été fait chez le clien: What was actually done at the client's. The invoice fills in from this work.
Ce qu'il y a dans chaque camion : huile,: What's in each truck: oil, filters, parts. When a job is done, what was used comes off the stock. An alert shows when you need to restock.
Si ton entreprise est inscrite aux taxes: If your business is registered for taxes, GST (5%) and QST (9.975%) are added to each invoice. Your numbers print at the bottom of the invoice.
Le prix d'une heure de travail. Il sert: The price of one hour of work. It's used when a service has no fixed price: hours × rate.
Un montant ajouté quand tu factures le d: An amount added when you charge for travel. Leave blank if you don't charge for it.
Facultatif. Le tableau de bord montre où: Optional. The dashboard shows where you stand against this amount each month.
Le code postal d'où partent les camions: The postal code the trucks leave from in the morning. It's used to work out routes and suggest the best times for a client.
Tes services à prix fixe. Quand tu fais: Your fixed-price services. When you make an invoice, one click on a service adds it with its price.
Un ensemble de services à un seul prix (: A bundle of services at one price (e.g. tires + oil). It shows first on the invoice as long as the “Offered right now” box is checked.
Les jours et heures où le garage prend d: The days and hours the garage takes appointments. For a day off or a special day, use “Open / close hours” in the schedule.
Chaque camion est une colonne de l'agend: Each truck is a column in the schedule. The usual mechanic goes out with the truck. A truck that isn't “In service” stays visible, but you can't book on it.
Les factures sont numérotées toutes seul: Invoices are numbered automatically, one after another (e.g. F-1, F-2). Only change this if you're continuing numbering you already had.
« Terminer la facture » lui donne son nu: “Finalize invoice” gives it its official number. “Finish later” keeps it without a number: you can complete it before sending it.
L'ordre des clients pour chaque camion,: The order of clients for each truck, with a link to open the route in Google Maps.
Ta position part vers le garage environ: Your location is sent to the garage about every 15 seconds, only between “Start my day” and “End of day”. The office sees where you are, and the client sees your route when you head to their place. Locations are erased after 30 days.
Les textos aux clients (« je pars », fac: Texts to clients (“on my way”, invoice, work to approve) are sent from your GoHighLevel account. Paste your key here just once.
Card payments go through Stripe. The client gets a “Pay” link by text; the money goes to your Stripe account and the invoice marks itself paid.
Coche un rôle ou plusieurs (par exemple: Check one or more roles (for example mechanic and treasurer). Mechanic: their jobs. Office: schedule, clients, invoices. Treasurer: expenses and reports. Owner: everything. Below, “Their permissions” shows what that gives them: you can add or remove a box for this person only.
« Client absent » : le client n'était pa: “No-show”: the client wasn't there for the appointment. Nothing is billed, and it's noted in their file for next time.
Pour vérifier ce qu'un mécano ou le trés: To check what a mechanic or the treasurer sees on their phone. It's not their account: your changes are saved under your name, and their workday (their location) doesn't start.
Ce tableau, c'est le départ de chaque rô: This table is the starting point for each role: a change here applies to everyone in that role. For just one person: “Edit” next to their name, then “Their permissions”. The owner can always do everything.
